clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal, a captive Scourge warrior tests the resolve of young Forsaken. Deathguard Dillinger sends you to release Ulag the Cleaver beneath a mausoleum north of Brill and face him in combat.

After the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, the Forsaken captured an unusual undead warrior who called himself Ulag the Cleaver. His mind remained clear, yet the Lich King still held his spirit in psychic thrall. The Forsaken bound him beneath a mausoleum north of Brill with a magical seal. They hoped to learn how the Scourge chained a mind and to break the hold over him.

The Forsaken failed to free Ulag from the Lich King's command. Deathguard Dillinger now uses the captive as a test of combat for rising Forsaken warriors. Disturbing the skull stone outside the crypt breaks the wards and frees Ulag from his prison. A warrior must face him with an axe, granting him release through death.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When the Scourge swept through Tirisfal Glades, we captured one to study. He had a free mind, and called himself Ulag the Cleaver. But, although his will was free, he was still enthralled by the Lich King.
We hoped to find a way to break the king's control over Ulag, but we failed. Now, finally, it is time to free him.
Activate the skull stone trigger near the mausoleum to the north. This will lift the magical seal that binds him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your task is yet undone, friend. It is not wise for a warrior to show fear...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. Ulag was no minor agent of the Scourge. You have shown the Deathguards, and hence the Dark Lady, that you are a warrior of skill and resolve, and are worthy of further instruction.
